question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at PQ as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85c248e61297840b1c6c2ccae18245cbda85f7489541bd4409fa9657e652db57.png]
solution:
The mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is place at the right side is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32004a67ead2a034685342333ba1e0a6b19a6bb79f3680804c2b76e3fd00bdbc.png] 

 
• The line PQ is the mirror.
 
• The given word "BINOMIAL" is written as BINOIMAL in option 2, positions of I, M are interchanged ⇒ Option 2 is eliminated.
 
• The given word "BINOMIAL" has third letter "N", so the mirror image should be " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23dc5d837b10689d4c2f87ce7b6f3e79f0c97d1ce653d00cad4c07d110cfca74.png] " ⇒ Option 3 is eliminated.
 
• The given word "BINOMIAL" is written as BINIOMAL in option 4, positions of O, I are interchanged ⇒ Option 4 is eliminated.

Hence, 'option 1' is the correct answer.
